title: Has anyone ever ran into an owl that can talk?
content: Sorry if this is off topic, but I had a vivid dream last night and right before I woke up, an owl flew up to me and started asking questions. The only one I remember was "do you live in *state I live in* most of the time?" It felt like it was gathering information on me. Maybe this has nothing to do with shared dream spaces and was just a weird me thing.
